newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia police seize hidden cigarettes.
newsitem.headline: Croatia police seize hidden cigarettes.

text.p: Croatian border police found 92,000 German marks ($53,000) worth of undeclared cigarettes hidden in furniture in a van, presumably part of an international smuggling chain, a customs official said on Friday.

Altogether 76,500 cigarette packs, including foreign-made Winston and HB, were found in the truck loaded with furniture at the Macelj border crossing with Slovenia last week, Marjan Hmelina of the customs told Reuters.
The driver, who has a police record, declared only the furniture, but the search showed contraband cigarettes carefully hidden in boxes in the centre of the truck.
"It is almost certain that this is about organised crime because the goods had also entered Croatia illegally," Hmelina said, adding the driver was still being questioned.
The van was heading for Germany, Hmelina said, though it was unclear where the cigarettes were to be sold.
Last October police seized 500,000 marks worth of cigarettes transiting Croatia in a Macedonian truck transporting frozen peppers. ($ = 1.734 German Marks)
